title: Лесная легенда
alt: Legend of the Forest Legend of the Forest 森の伝説
description: A tranquil forest and all of its residents must face the destruction of man. A squirrel, born and raised in the forrest, fights to defend his home and faces trials and adversities along the way. (Source: Anime News Network)

en:
A tranquil forest and all of its residents must face the destruction of man. A squirrel, born and raised in the forrest, fights to defend his home and faces trials and adversities along the way.



(Source: Anime News Network)
